description: In chat.rs handle_chat_set update loop: Ok(_) => { updated.insert(id_str.clone(), Value::Null) }. The backend's update_object returns Result<Option<O>, _>; Some(O) signals server-modified fields that RFC 8620 §5.3 requires the handler to echo in the updated map. The wildcard match discards the object and always inserts null, so clients never see server-modified fields. mail-server/mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set correctly uses maybe_obj.as_ref().and_then(|o| serde_json::to_value(o).ok()).unwrap_or(Value::Null); chat-server diverges by always writing null.
title: Chat/set update ignores update_object Some(O) return
